original.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 bumps its pinned golang build dependency from 1.24.1 to 1.24.2.

decision.reason: [ev-2d0b91a93b8e] only lists a Dependabot bump of golang from 1.24.1 to 1.24.2 in the v0.16.0 release. It names no configuration, value, resource or flag that would make one environment more exposed than another. A build-toolchain bump reaches every environment that upgrades to 0.16.0 from an earlier version, so edge-from-version <0.16.0 is neither broader nor narrower than the real exposure. Confidence is low because the evidence doesn't say whether the bump affects the shipped binaries/images or only CI, but either way no narrower predicate follows from it.
